title: C6 approval-card provenance (delta, round 3)
head: 4019f48617d796b71db0c89c6eec2884c23a337f
brief: Chat-to-chat C6, display only. An approval card raised by a call from a turn that another chat's message started (a relayed turn, in the target chat), or that its reply started (a reply turn, in the sender), says which chat's message started the turn, under REQUESTED BY. Claims: no permission layer reads the provenance; a sub-agent's call in a relayed turn carries the line too; the chat title is reduced so it cannot forge or restyle the card; the HUD draws the line without changing buttons, focus or Tab order; nothing adds a path from a message to an approval. A call a relayed turn did not start now gets kind 'running' (wording 'while a turn started by ... runs'); a child's first-seen record only stamps if it arrives in the turn that spawned it.
focus: display-only: the decision, layer, reason, Always offer and waits are unchanged
untrusted chat titles on an authorization surface
SELF_PROTECTED hunks in permissions.py and approvals.py
provenance of background sub-agents across turns
no lock taken by the card reader

ground_truth.mechanism: a child whose parent the daemon never saw (parent_sid None because Claude's CHILD_LIMIT dropped its task_started), or whose first record is a subagent_event, is stamped 'started' from the running turn
ground_truth.evidence: grandchild starts during relayed turn T2 and is stamped 'turn started by chat S'

ground_truth.mechanism: the 'grandchild of a seen, unstamped parent' branch (elif parent in seen: stamp = None) is not pinned; a mutant falling back to the running turn survives both suites
ground_truth.evidence: mutant m4 survives relay_provenance_check and permissions_check

ground_truth.mechanism: if the CLI emits a relayed turn's child task_started only after the turn's result, the watcher reads it idle, marks it seen with no stamp, and the child never shows a line; ordering unverified
ground_truth.evidence: could not be verified from code; pre-stamp from the spawning Agent call or add an L4 live check

ground_truth.mechanism: a live child evicted from the 4096-entry seen set would be restamped
ground_truth.evidence: read _stamp_child's seen set at this head: it is capped (CHILD_SEEN, 4096 entries) and pops the oldest, so a live child evicted from it appears new on its next record and is stamped from the running turn; a test that records 5000 children then re-announces the first one shows it
